title: Stunning Custom Contemporary Home in Park City, Utah
description:
Presented by Summit Sotheby's International Realty

For more information go to http://s.sir.com/2caCGJV

Right off the pages of Architectural Digest, this amazing designer home screams quality as soon as you step in the foyer. A newly built Old Town home, attention to detail is evident in its many handcrafted details, unique finishes, and organic modern style. The house boasts a beautiful suspended staircase cascading through all four levels, and features the best of the best in design: sleek automated cabinetry, Miele appliances, and Manzoni hardware. The large indoor and outdoor spaces are a bonus for entertaining, including a great room with vaulted ceilings and custom lighting, separate family room with state of the art entertainment system and wet bar, as well as a top floor patio to dine in beautiful views of Park City. Should you ever choose to leave, a short walk takes you to the hustle and bustle of Main Street or easy ski access. From its gorgeous handcrafted black walnut breakfast bar, to the outdoor water feature making you feel like you are miles in the country, You will not find property similar with such impeccable style and detail in Old Town.
